lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: refreshing Cargo.lock would pull transitive versions that never passed the 3-day minimum release age. Transitive updates arrive only with age-gated direct updates.

packageRules.description: Bump the toolchain and every workspace's rust-version together; xtask tests require them equal.

axum and tokio-tungstenite move together. axum's ws feature depends on one tokio-tungstenite version and cargo-deny refuses two versions of a crate in the lockfile, so the worker's tokio-tungstenite can move only when axum's does: #18 (tokio-tungstenite 0.30) was closed because axum 0.8.9 still needs 0.29.

Hold tokio-tungstenite at the version axum's ws feature depends on (0.29 for axum 0.8.9 in Cargo.lock). The group above still opened a pull request for tokio-tungstenite alone (#26) whenever it had a release axum did not take yet, and cargo-deny refuses the two versions that makes. When an axum update needs a newer tokio-tungstenite, its pull request fails cargo-deny's duplicate check: raise this bound to that version's successor in the same pull request, and bump the workspace's tokio-tungstenite with it.

The web app's npm packages (web/package.json, locked in web/pnpm-lock.yaml): exact versions, which pnpm-workspace.yaml's savePrefix keeps, past the same 3-day minimum release age that pnpm's minimumReleaseAge enforces at install.
React and its type definitions move together: @types/react and @types/react-dom describe one React release.
Tailwind CSS and its Vite plugin are released together and must match.
oxlint's type-aware rules run in oxlint-tsgolint, which each oxlint release names a version of.
Vitest and its coverage provider must be the same version.
node in xtask/tools.toml stays on an LTS line: Renovate proposes no odd-numbered, short-lived major.

tailscaled and the Go that builds it (packaging/tailscale.toml) move together: `cargo xtask release go` refuses a Go other than the one Tailscale's go.mod names. go.dev's archive sha256s are pinned beside the version, and Renovate cannot compute them.
prBodyNotes: When Go's version changes, copy the sha256 go.dev publishes for each of the three archives in `packaging/tailscale.toml` from https://go.dev/dl/ and commit them: the release workflow refuses any other archive.

packageRules.description: Pinned tools need new checksums with every version.
prBodyNotes: Renovate cannot pin, and `cargo xtask setup` refuses archives whose sha256 is not pinned, so this pull request is not merged: an agent runs `cargo xtask pr renovate <number>`, which opens a replacement with the bump pinned and closes this one with a link to it.
